snippet.title: Macaulay Culkin & Brenda Song Quiz Each Other on Their Careers | Cosmopolitan
snippet.description:
Macaulay Culkin and Brenda Song have been together since 2017, but does all that time together mean they know each other’s careers inside and out? In this playful Cosmo Couples quiz, the two get super competitive, from Brenda nailing which co-star bit Macaulay’s finger (and kissing his booboo) to Macaulay calling London Tipton’s catchphrase a "layup"—yay him! Watch as they realize they both starred in Christmas movies, share their love for Jamie Lee Curtis, and rave about each other’s work in the sweetest way. Brenda confidently declares, “We both won at life, but I won at these quizzes”—but who will truly come out on top?

snippet.title: Macaulay Culkin Tears Up Over 'Home Alone' Mom Catherine O'Hara's Loving Support
snippet.description:
Macaulay Culkin wasn't "Home Alone" for his latest career milestone! The actor stepped out to receive his star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame on Dec. 1 and received support from longtime love Brenda Song and their two children. Macaulay's famous friends and co-stars including Catherine O'Hara, Natasha Lyonne, Seth Green and more were also on hand for the event, along with the actor's brother, Rory Culkin, and goddaughter, Paris Jackson. Macaulay took to the podium to share gratitude for the professional landmark and reveal how touched he was to receive such loving speeches from Catherine and Natasha, and he also teared up when thanking Brenda for her unwavering support.

snippet.title: Remembering Catherine O’Hara…🕊️💔
snippet.description:
The world lost a true legend when Catherine O'Hara, the Emmy-winning actress and comedy icon, passed away on January 30th, 2026. While she was known to millions as the eccentric Moira Rose in *Schitt's Creek,* Kevin’s mom in *Home Alone*, and countless other iconic roles, her heart was always grounded in reality. When asked which legendary role she most wanted to be remembered for, she didn't choose a character, but simply replied: "Mother to my children." Our hearts are with her family, and we hope this tribute edit honors the laughter and love she gave us all. ⚡

(ABOUT THIS MOVIE)

Home Alone is a 1990 American Christmas comedy film directed by Chris Columbus, and written and produced by John Hughes. The first film in the Home Alone franchise, the film stars Macaulay Culkin as Kevin McCallister, an eight-year-old boy who defends his suburban Chicago home from a home invasion by a pair of robbers after his family accidentally leaves him behind on their Christmas vacation to Paris. The cast also features Joe Pesci, Daniel Stern, John Heard, and Catherine O'Hara.

Her cause of death is unknown.
